item.text: The campaign is ready: $160 allocated across two posts through Sunday, with $40 reserved for Monday’s soundtrack post, which makes no bonus-track promise. X’s country catalogue omits all four unavailable markets; delivery will use its available worldwide inventory without age or language restrictions. The ad-group lifetime caps total $200 USD.
At Thursday noon Perth time, X reports $14.88 spent and 31 link clicks. Both posts are delivering; the sample is too small to justify shifting the budget yet.

By Friday noon, the campaign has spent $52.07 for 109 link clicks. The descriptive score post is averaging about $0.45 per click versus $0.52 for “Send them a song.” I’m shifting $20 of the remaining allocation toward the descriptive post while keeping both running into Valentine’s weekend.
Saturday’s check shows $97.04 spent and 208 link clicks. The descriptive post still has the lower click cost, so I’m keeping the current allocation. Monday’s $40 remains reserved.
At noon on Valentine’s Day, spend is $132.54 with 293 link clicks. The weekend ads are scheduled to end at midnight Perth time, when the Monday soundtrack ad takes over.

The weekend promotions have stopped. By Monday noon, total spend is $166.10 with 362 link clicks. I’m moving the weekend’s unused $5.86 into Monday’s allocation, keeping the combined lifetime caps at $200.
The five-day campaign has ended, and all ad groups are paused. I’ll pull the closing totals after one more reporting update.

The campaign ran February 11–15, 2027, Perth time, and is now stopped.

- **Impressions:** 783,470
- **Link clicks:** 400
- **Average cost per click:** $0.50 USD
